disposition_mapping.rationale: Council near-unanimously agreed (maximalist, pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, and accounting_standards without objection) that multi-channel logging and extraction are triggered by the same event and are already treated as one continuous flow by modern capture tooling. The merge is low-risk and reversible via an exception queue, and no KB principle attaches to intake mechanics. This step was flagged unconstrained_by_design, permitting full flexibility; the merge preserves the source-document pointer required for the downstream evidence chain (KB-09) and logs the capture sub-event separately per agentic_architect's and finance_domain's Round 2 concession on internal audit granularity.

Extraction/validation merges into the same capture step for the same reasons as VIP-01. hitl_designer's and agentic_architect's non-negotiable that low-confidence extractions route to a human clerk with the source image, rather than auto-accepting after timeout, is preserved as the step's exception path. emerging_economy's requirement that this remain batch/offline-capable, and that OCR-displaced clerks be redeployed to the exception queue rather than simply eliminated, is incorporated into the step design.

The council decisively rejected maximalist's proposal to fold matching into the same step as capture/extraction: pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, emerging_economy, agentic_architect and accounting_standards independently held that matching is a distinct evidentiary act (KB-09: the PO-GRN-invoice chain establishes cost under IAS 2, not merely a fraud control) that must keep its own audit boundary, separate from both the capture step preceding it and the human exception step following it, so that a disputed cost figure can be traced to a specific match event. This synthesis follows the majority. VIP-R-01 and VIP-R-02 are satisfied directly: PO data and GRN data remain explicit, mandatory consumed inputs. Auto-clearing of clean/tolerance matches is added per the council's broad consensus, gated by hitl_designer's non-negotiable of a named tolerance-policy owner and periodic human sample-audit, and made batch-capable per emerging_economy so the control does not depend on continuous connectivity.

The council majority (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, accounting_standards) held firmly against maximalist's and emerging_economy's proposals to shrink or merge exception handling into the matching engine or a single generalist role. Exception resolution is the judgment-bearing, human-decided act that KB-05 (IAS 8 error correction) protects, and it must produce a documented rationale and an audit trail, not an algorithmic default. This synthesis retains it as a standalone step, but scopes it (per hitl_designer's and finance_domain's Round 2 concessions) to a realistic volume driven by GRN latency in decentralised-receiving environments, and requires unresolved holds to feed the period-close accrual process, closing the gap finance_domain, accounting_standards and maximalist all independently identified.

This is a decisive call on the council's sharpest unresolved conflict. Maximalist, finance_domain, hitl_designer and agentic_architect converged on risk-tiered automated approval for low-risk, in-policy, clean-matched invoices below a materiality threshold, with human approval reserved for above-threshold, exception-resolved, override or new-vendor cases; accounting_standards held this is a workflow-requirements question, not one the KB settles, since no KB entry requires the approving actor to be human, and KB-11/KB-02 can be satisfied by a properly logged policy decision. Pragmatist alone insisted on unchanged manual approval pending separate change control. The synthesis adopts the four-member majority position: a governed policy engine executing the board-approved matrix is approval, not its absence, provided the accountable owner, distinct actor status from the poster, and full-context human escalation hitl_designer specified are present. VIP-R-03 (approval survives), VIP-R-04 (precedes payment), and VIP-R-06 (distinct actor from posting) are all satisfied structurally, not merely by policy convention, per emerging_economy's and accounting_standards' insistence.

The council agreed posting must survive as a discrete, non-bypassable step performed by an actor distinct from the approver (VIP-R-05, VIP-R-06), and that this is the accrual-recognition point under KB-01 and the recognition event for the payable as a financial instrument under KB-11. On coding placement, the council was divided: finance_domain and maximalist proposed moving coding upstream into matching for clean PO matches; agentic_architect and hitl_designer held that coding application belongs with posting because folding it into matching blurs which agent is accountable when coding is later found wrong, and hitl_designer noted the human coding-confirmation gate is only meaningful at the point the decision is actually made. This synthesis follows agentic_architect/hitl_designer: coding inheritance for clean PO-backed matches is automated within the posting step itself (satisfying pragmatist's Round 2 concession that re-keying an already-decided code is redundant), while non-PO, new-cost-centre or override coding requires mandatory AP-accountant review before posting, preserving finance_domain's condition that the restatement risk in the exception population is not automated away.

Payment execution survives (VIP-R-08) as a distinct step, kept separate from reconciliation per the strong majority (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, accounting_standards) against maximalist's merge, on the grounds that 'cash left the building' and 'the ledger agrees with the bank' are different assertions checked against different evidence and that collapsing them removes the seam a fraud investigator or auditor needs. The step is restructured to add controls the baseline was silent on but multiple members treated as non-negotiable: mandatory vendor bank-detail verification against a change-controlled master (pragmatist, hitl_designer, finance_domain, emerging_economy all converged on this), an affirmative human release gate for threshold/first-time-payee/bank-detail-change payments (hitl_designer, agentic_architect), multi-rail/multi-currency capability for non-tier-one settlement environments (emerging_economy), and explicit exchange-difference tracking rather than invisible netting (KB-08, accounting_standards, finance_domain, maximalist).

Reconciliation survives (VIP-R-07) as its own step, distinct from payment execution, per the same majority rejection of maximalist's merged TGT-05. accounting_standards' and pragmatist's shared insistence that a discrete, individually accountable 'reconciled as of [period]' attestation must survive as a produced artefact, not a query-driven or continuously-rolling status, is adopted directly (KB-03 cutoff discipline, KB-02 evidential traceability). The mechanics are restructured toward continuous or near-real-time matching where feeds allow, with an explicit manual/batch fallback for non-electronic feeds (emerging_economy), and the step's inputs are extended to explicitly consume the open exception/hold register from exception investigation so GRIR and in-flight-exception accruals are captured rather than silently dropped from the period-end balance, closing the gap finance_domain, accounting_standards, maximalist and agentic_architect all independently raised in Round 2.

steps.actor: Capture and extraction agent (OCR/AI) with AP clerk exception queue
steps.description: A capture engine ingests invoices from all channels (email PDF, EDI, portal, paper scan) and extracts header, line, tax and PO-reference data in one continuous pass. High-confidence extractions flow straight through as structured validated records; extractions below a defined confidence threshold, or malformed/unreadable submissions, route to an AP clerk exception queue with the source document and proposed values. The capture event and the extraction/validation event are separately logged sub-actions within this step, and a pointer to the original source document is retained as the first link in the evidence chain. The capture logic is batch/offline-capable so that intake continues when real-time connectivity to downstream systems is unavailable.
inputs: Vendor invoice (email PDF, EDI, supplier portal or paper)
steps.name: Invoice capture and extraction
outputs: Structured validated invoice record with source-document pointer
Separately logged capture and extraction sub-event records

steps.actor: Matching engine (agent) with named tolerance-policy owner
steps.description: A matching engine consumes the structured invoice record together with purchase order data and goods receipt note data and applies board-approved tolerance rules, auto-clearing clean and in-tolerance matches without human touch. A named, accountable policy owner holds the tolerance thresholds on a fixed review cycle, and a periodic human sample-audit of auto-cleared matches guards against the 'within tolerance' population becoming an unmonitored channel for systematic overbilling. Matching runs on a batch or scheduled basis where real-time connectivity or GRN data is unavailable, so the control does not degrade in low-bandwidth or decentralised-receiving environments. Invoices that fail tolerance, lack a GRN, are duplicates, or carry a fraud flag are routed to exception investigation as a distinct, separately evidenced act, not folded into capture or auto-cleared silently.
steps.name: Automated three-way matching
outputs: Auto-cleared clean/in-tolerance match record with rule basis logged

steps.description: Genuine variances that the matching engine cannot safely auto-clear — price/quantity disputes, missing or delayed GRNs, duplicate-invoice flags, master-data discrepancies — are investigated by an AP analyst with full evidentiary context (variance detail, PO, GRN, vendor history), not a summary score. Resolution is recorded as approved, rejected or held, with a documented rationale, preserving the human-decided, audit-trailed correction path IAS 8 requires. This step is resourced for a realistic exception volume, including routine missing-GRN holds where receiving is manual or decentralised, not treated as a residual afterthought. Unresolved holds are surfaced to the period-close step as accrual candidates rather than disappearing from the AP balance.
steps.name: Exception investigation and resolution
outputs: Resolved invoice (approved, rejected or held) with documented rationale
Open hold register entries for accrual review

steps.actor: Approval policy engine (named accountable owner) and human approver hierarchy
steps.description: A policy engine, executing the board-approved approval matrix as encoded rules, auto-authorises clean-matched, in-policy invoices below a defined materiality/risk threshold; this constitutes a genuine, logged authorisation event, not a bypass of approval. Above-threshold invoices, non-clean matches, exception-resolved invoices, new-vendor cases and any override are routed to a human approver from the hierarchy, who sees the match result, GL coding proposal and exception rationale in full, not a bare amount. A named accountable owner holds the auto-approval thresholds under periodic review. The approval actor (engine or human) is architecturally and system-role distinct from the posting actor in TGT-05, and authorisation always completes before payment scheduling begins in TGT-06.
inputs: Approval matrix encoded as policy rules
steps.name: Risk-tiered approval authorisation
outputs: Approval audit trail with rule/decision basis
Escalation log for above-threshold or override cases

steps.description: For clean, PO-backed matches, GL coding is inherited automatically from the account/cost-centre assignment already made at requisition; for non-PO invoices, new cost centres or any override, an AP accountant reviews and confirms coding before posting. The accountant, distinct in role and system credentials from the approver in TGT-04, posts the approved invoice to the general ledger and AP subledger. Postings are immutable-logged with invoice ID, approver ID and timestamp; corrections occur via reversing entries, never overwrites, keeping the recognition event — the point at which the payable is first recognised as a financial instrument (IFRS 9) on an accrual basis (IAS 1) — determinable and auditable.
steps.name: GL coding and posting
outputs: Immutable posting log with reversing-entry correction mechanism

steps.actor: Treasury/AP payments officer (distinct from posting and approval)
steps.description: Posted invoices are scheduled against payment terms, verified vendor bank details and the cash position, with support for multiple settlement rails (ACH/wire, correspondent banking, mobile money) and multi-day confirmation timelines. Vendor bank details are verified against a change-controlled master before file transmission, and any payment above a threshold, to a first-time payee, or to a vendor whose bank details changed since the last cycle requires an affirmative human release action — this is the highest fraud-exposure point in the chain and is never fully automated. Exchange differences on foreign-currency invoices are captured and reported explicitly, never netted invisibly into the payment amount. Payment confirmation is captured as a determinable, timestamped derecognition event, distinct from the reconciliation step that follows.
steps.name: Payment scheduling and execution

steps.description: Bank confirmations, the AP subledger and vendor statements are reconciled on a continuous or near-real-time basis where electronic feeds allow, with a documented manual/batch fallback preserved where bank or vendor statement formats are non-electronic. Unmatched or aged items route to the AP accountant for individual review, and the open exception/hold register from TGT-03 is explicitly consumed so that unresolved goods-received-not-invoiced positions and in-flight exceptions surface as accrual candidates rather than dropping from the period-end balance. Regardless of how continuous the underlying matching becomes, a discrete, individually accountable 'reconciled as of [period]' attestation is produced as a mandatory gate before the period locks, satisfying cutoff discipline and keeping the reported AP balance evidentially traceable.
inputs: Open exception/hold register from exception investigation
steps.name: Reconciliation and period close
